replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Not really. I find math quite grounding and predictable. My high conscientiousness helps me stay organized with practice, and I don't typically experience anxiety around it. The logical nature of math actually calms me down, especially when compared to subjects like economics that feel too abstract and uncertain to my personality.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: Yes, I used a few tutoring apps and chatbots for explanations. It was helpful for breaking down complex steps, though I prefer working through problems myself first. The AI tools were good for review, but I found them more useful when I had specific questions about biology applications rather than just general math theory.
